xhtml:iframe.title: Home - Classroom
xhtml:iframe.srcdoc:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" style="--accent: #e08e00; --bg-pattern: none;"><head>
<meta http-equiv="content-type" content="text/html; charset=UTF-8">
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Home - Classroom</title>

  <link id="favicon" rel="icon" type="image/png" href="https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQKc9GqsXgnUKInxlppDY9eFPcHnXpL4Rwd-WUTScoMALqVm2AoSnrSk1EU&s=10">
  
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #07090c;
      --panel: #0d1117;
      --panel2: #111720;
      --text: #f2f5f7;
      --muted: #8995a3;
      --accent: #e08e00;
      --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, .09);
      --radial-glow: rgba(66, 217, 255, .10);
      --bg-pattern: none;
    }

    /* Light Mode Preset Overrides */
    [data-theme="light"] {
      --bg: #f4f6f8;
      --panel: #ffffff;
      --panel2: #eaeeF3;
      --text: #0d1117;
      --muted: #596572;
      --accent: #0d1117;
      --border: rgba(0, 0, 0, .12);
      --radial-glow: rgba(0, 0, 0, .03);
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body {
      margin: 0;
      min-height: 100%;
      background-color: var(--bg);
      background-image: 
        var(--bg-pattern),
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% -10%, var(--radial-glow), transparent 35%);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease;
    }
    
    body { padding: 42px 18px 70px; }
    .wrap { width: min(980px, 100%); margin: auto; }
    header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 30px; }
    
    h1 { margin: 13px 0 2px; font-size: clamp(42px, 8vw, 72px); line-height: .95; letter-spacing: -.055em; }
    h1 span { color: var(--accent); transition: color 0.3s ease; }
    h4 { margin: 11px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; }
    
    /* Live Clock between Title and Subtitle */
    .header-clock {
      display: none;
      font-family: monospace;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--accent);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 4px 12px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      width: fit-content;
      margin: 8px auto;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .header-clock { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); }
    .header-clock.active { display: inline-block; }

    .search {
      width: 100%; margin: 20px 0 15px; padding: 15px 17px;
      color: var(--text); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 13px; outline: none; font-size: 15px;
    }
    .search:focus { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, .05); }
    
    .list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
    .game {
      min-height: 58px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 15px 16px;
      color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--panel), var(--panel2));
      border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 13px;
      transition: transform .16s ease, border-color .16s ease, background .16s ease; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .game:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--accent); }
    .game:active { transform: translateY(0); }
    .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; flex: 0 0 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent); }
    .game span:nth-child(2) { flex: 1; font-weight: 650; }
    .arrow { color: var(--muted); font-size: 18px; }
    .empty { display: none; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); padding: 35px; }
    footer { text-align: center; margin-top: 26px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }

    /* Floating Settings Icon */
    .settings-btn {
      position: fixed; bottom: 12px; right: 12px; width: 26px; height: 26px;
      background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer;
      opacity: 0.3; transition: opacity 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; z-index: 1000;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0;
    }
    .settings-btn:hover { opacity: 0.9; }
    .settings-btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; }

    /* Modal Backdrop */
    .modal-overlay {
      position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); display: none;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 1001;
    }
    .modal-overlay.active { display: flex; }

    /* Settings Window */
    .modal {
      background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px; width: min(480px, 92%); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
      overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    }
    .modal-header {
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
      padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .modal-header h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; color: var(--text); }
    .modal-close {
      background: none; border: none; color: var(--muted); font-size: 20px;
      cursor: pointer; padding: 0; line-height: 1;
    }

    /* Tab Nav */
    .tab-nav { display: flex; background: var(--panel2); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .tab-btn {
      flex: 1; padding: 10px 8px; background: none; border: none;
      color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer;
      border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .tab-btn.active { color: var(--accent); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); }

    /* Tab Panels */
    .tab-content { padding: 20px; display: none; }
    .tab-content.active { display: block; }
    .field-group { margin-bottom: 15px; }
    .field-group label { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .field-group input, .field-group select, .field-group textarea {
      width: 100%; padding: 10px; background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text); font-size: 13px; font-family: inherit; outline: none;
    }

    /* Toggle Switch */
    .toggle-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 15px; }
    .toggle-row span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text); }
    .switch { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 40px; height: 22px; }
    .switch input { opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; }
    .slider {
      position: absolute; cursor: pointer; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      background-color: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--border); transition: .2s; border-radius: 22px;
    }
    .slider:before {
      position: absolute; content: ""; height: 14px; width: 14px; left: 3px; bottom: 3px;
      background-color: var(--muted); transition: .2s; border-radius: 50%;
    }
    input:checked + .slider { background-color: var(--accent); }
    input:checked + .slider:before { transform: translateX(18px); background-color: #000; }

    .btn {
      padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: var(--panel2); color: var(--text); font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
  </style>

src="Home%20-%20Classroom_files/inspector_nA56.js" integrity="sha384-61Rdje1eFJMb+/wB1xwo/TJeDw8zxe794wB7CCpglaiKTO46kYlkYOnntWbMdec6" crossorigin="anonymous"></script><script>
/**
 * IDE Inline Console Enhancement - Minimal Version
 * Inject this directly in <head> to catch ALL console calls from the start
 */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // Prevent multiple installations
  if (window.__IDE_CONSOLE_ENHANCED__) return;
  window.__IDE_CONSOLE_ENHANCED__ = true;

  // Store originals immediately
  const originals = {
    log: console.log.bind(console),
    error: console.error.bind(console),
    warn: console.warn.bind(console),
  };

  // Fast line info function
  function getLineInfo() {
    try {
      const stack = new Error().stack;
      if (!stack) return "";

      const lines = stack.split("\n");
      for (let i = 3; i < Math.min(lines.length, 8); i++) {
        const line = lines[i];
        if (line && (line.includes(".html:") || line.includes(".js:"))) {
                     const match = line.match(/([^\/\s]+\.(html|js)):(\d+):(\d+)/);
           if (match && match[3] && match[4]) {
             const filename = match[1].split("/").pop();
             return ` [${filename}:${match[3]}:${match[4]}]`;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Ignore errors
    }
    return "";
  }

  // Enhanced console functions
  console.log = function (...args) {
    try {
      if (args.length > 0 && typeof args[0] === "string") {
        const lineInfo = getLineInfo();
        if (lineInfo) args[0] += lineInfo;
      }
      originals.log.apply(null, args);
    } catch (e) {
      originals.log.apply(null, arguments);
    }
  };

  console.error = function (...args) {
    try {
      if (args.length > 0 && typeof args[0] === "string") {
        const lineInfo = getLineInfo();
        if (lineInfo) args[0] += lineInfo;
      }
      originals.error.apply(null, args);

      // Auto-show Eruda on errors (if available)
      setTimeout(() => {
        try {
          if (window.eruda && window.eruda.show) {
            window.eruda.show();
            window.eruda.console.show();
          }
        } catch (e) {
          // Ignore
        }
      }, 50);
    } catch (e) {
      originals.error.apply(null, arguments);
    }
  };

  console.warn = function (...args) {
    try {
      if (args.length > 0 && typeof args[0] === "string") {
        const lineInfo = getLineInfo();
        if (lineInfo) args[0] += lineInfo;
      }
      originals.warn.apply(null, args);
    } catch (e) {
      originals.warn.apply(null, arguments);
    }
  };

  // Load Eruda
  function loadEruda() {
    if (typeof eruda !== "undefined") return;

    const script = document.createElement("script");
    script.src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/eruda";
    script.onload = function () {
      try {
        eruda.init();

        // Configure after a delay
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (eruda.config) {
            eruda.config.set("displaySize", 60);
            eruda.config.set("transparency", 0.9);
          }
          if (eruda.console && eruda.console.config) {
            eruda.console.config.set("displayFunctionName", true);
            eruda.console.config.set("maxLogNum", 1000);
          }
        }, 200);
      } catch (e) {
        // Ignore init failures
      }
    };

    // Add script when DOM is available
    function addScript() {
      (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(script);
    }

    if (document.head || document.documentElement) {
      addScript();
    } else {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", addScript);
    }
  }

  // Load Eruda immediately
  loadEruda();

  // Global error handlers
  window.addEventListener("error", function (e) {
    try {
      console.error("Uncaught error:", e.error || e.message);
    } catch (ex) {
      // Ignore
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", function (e) {
    try {
      console.error("Unhandled promise rejection:", e.reason);
    } catch (ex) {
      // Ignore
    }
  });
})();
</script></head><div id="eruda" style="all: initial;"></div><div class="__chobitsu-hide__" style="all: initial;"></div>

  <!-- Settings Button -->
  <button class="settings-btn" id="openSettings" title="Settings">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19.14 12.94c.04-.3.06-.61.06-.94 0-.32-.02-.64-.07-.94l2.03-1.58c.18-.14.23-.41.12-.61l-1.92-3.32c-.12-.22-.37-.29-.59-.22l-2.39.96c-.5-.38-1.03-.7-1.62-.94l-.36-2.54c-.04-.24-.24-.41-.48-.41h-3.84c-.24 0-.43.17-.47.41l-.36 2.54c-.59.24-1.13.57-1.62.94l-2.39-.96c-.22-.08-.47 0-.59.22L2.74 8.87c-.12.21-.08.47.12.61l2.03 1.58c-.05.3-.09.63-.09.94s.02.64.07.94l-2.03 1.58c-.18.14-.23.41-.12.61l1.92 3.32c.12.22.37.29.59.22l2.39-.96c.5.38 1.03.7 1.62.94l.36 2.54c.05.24.24.41.48.41h3.84c.24 0 .44-.17.47-.41l.36-2.54c.59-.24 1.13-.56 1.62-.94l2.39.96c.22.08.47 0 .59-.22l1.92-3.32c.12-.22.07-.47-.12-.61l-2.01-1.58zM12 15.6c-1.98 0-3.6-1.62-3.6-3.6s1.62-3.6 3.6-3.6 3.6 1.62 3.6 3.6-1.62 3.6-3.6 3.6z"></path></svg>
  </button>

  <!-- Multi-Tab Settings Modal -->
  <div class="modal-overlay" id="settingsModal">
    <div class="modal">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h3>Hub Settings</h3>
        <button class="modal-close" id="closeSettings">×</button>
      </div>

      <div class="tab-nav">
        <button class="tab-btn active" data-tab="themeTab">Themes</button>
        <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="cloakingTab">Cloaking</button>
        <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="base64Tab">Base64 Tool</button>
        <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="clockTab">Clock</button>
      </div>

      <!-- Tab: Themes & Backgrounds -->
      <div class="tab-content active" id="themeTab">
        <div class="field-group">
          <label>Accent Theme</label>
          <select id="themeSelect">
            <option value="#e08e00" selected="selected">Orange (Original)</option>
            <option value="#39d9ff">Blue</option>
            <option value="#ff4d4d">Red</option>
            <option value="#ffd700">Yellow</option>
            <option value="#b366ff">Purple</option>
            <option value="#ffffff">White</option>
            <option value="light">Light Mode (Black Theme)</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="field-group">
          <label>Custom Pattern Overlay</label>
          <select id="bgPatternSelect">
            <option value="none" selected="selected">None (Default)</option>
            <option value="stripes">Stripes</option>
            <option value="stars">Little Stars (White)</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Tab: Cloaking -->
      <div class="tab-content" id="cloakingTab">
        <div class="field-group">
          <label>Page Title</label>
          <input type="text" id="titleInput" value="Home - Classroom" placeholder="Enter custom title...">
        </div>
        <div class="field-group">
          <label>Preset Favicon</label>
          <select id="iconPreset">
            <option value="custom">Custom URL Below</option>
            <option value="https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQKc9GqsXgnUKInxlppDY9eFPcHnXpL4Rwd-WUTScoMALqVm2AoSnrSk1EU&s=10" selected="selected">Google Classroom</option>
            <option value="https://www.google.com/favicon.ico">Google Search</option>
            <option value="https://ssl.gstatic.com/docs/doclist/images/drive_2020q4_32dp.png">Google Drive</option>
            <option value="https://canvas.instructure.com/favicon.ico">Canvas</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="field-group">
          <label>Favicon Icon URL</label>
          <input type="text" id="iconInput" value="https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQKc9GqsXgnUKInxlppDY9eFPcHnXpL4Rwd-WUTScoMALqVm2AoSnrSk1EU&s=10">
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Tab: Base64 Encoder / Decoder -->
      <div class="tab-content" id="base64Tab">
        <div class="field-group">
          <label>Input URL / String</label>
          <input type="text" id="toolInput" placeholder="Paste link or Base64...">
        </div>
        <div class="field-group">
          <label>Result</label>
          <textarea id="toolOutput" rows="3" placeholder="Output will appear here..." readonly="readonly"></textarea>
        </div>
        <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px;">
          <button class="btn" id="btnEncode">Encode</button>
          <button class="btn" id="btnDecode">Decode</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Tab: Clock Toggle -->
      <div class="tab-content" id="clockTab">
        <div class="toggle-row">
          <span>Enable Live Clock in Header</span>
          <label class="switch">
            <input type="checkbox" id="clockToggle">
            <span class="slider"></span>
          </label>
        </div>
        <p style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin: 0;">Displays a real-time digital clock synchronized down to the second between the title and subtext.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    (function () {
      function init() {
        // SVG Pattern Definitions
        var patterns = {
          none: 'none',
          stripes: 'repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 10px, transparent 10px, transparent 20px)',
          stars: 'radial-gradient(1px 1px at 20px 30px, #ffffff, rgba(0,0,0,0)), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 40px 70px, #ffffff, rgba(0,0,0,0)), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 50px 160px, #ffffff, rgba(0,0,0,0)), radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 80px 120px, #ffffff, rgba(0,0,0,0)), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 110px 40px, #ffffff, rgba(0,0,0,0)), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 130px 80px, #ffffff, rgba(0,0,0,0))'
        };

        // 1. Base64 Link Open
        document.querySelectorAll('.game').forEach(function (link) {
          link.addEventListener('click', function () {
            var b64 = this.getAttribute('data-b64');
            if (b64) {
              try { this.href = atob(b64); } catch (e) {}
            }
          });
        });

        // 2. Search Filter
        var search = document.getElementById("search");
        var games = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".game"));
        var empty = document.getElementById("empty");

        function filter() {
          var q = (search.value || "").trim().toLowerCase();
          var visible = 0;
          games.forEach(function (game) {
            var show = !q || (game.textContent || "").toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
            game.style.display = show ? "flex" : "none";
            if (show) visible++;
          });
          if (empty) empty.style.display = visible ? "none" : "block";
        }

        if (search) {
          search.addEventListener("input", filter);
          search.addEventListener("keyup", filter);
          search.addEventListener("change", filter);
          filter();
        }

        // 3. Modal Settings Toggle Logic
        var modal = document.getElementById("settingsModal");
        var openBtn = document.getElementById("openSettings");
        var closeBtn = document.getElementById("closeSettings");

        openBtn.addEventListener("click", function() { modal.classList.add("active"); });
        closeBtn.addEventListener("click", function() { modal.classList.remove("active"); });
        modal.addEventListener("click", function(e) { if (e.target === modal) modal.classList.remove("active"); });

        // 4. Tab Navigation Switcher
        var tabBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn");
        var tabContents = document.querySelectorAll(".tab-content");

        tabBtns.forEach(function(btn) {
          btn.addEventListener("click", function() {
            tabBtns.forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove("active"); });
            tabContents.forEach(function(c) { c.classList.remove("active"); });
            this.classList.add("active");
            document.getElementById(this.getAttribute("data-tab")).classList.add("active");
          });
        });

        // 5. Cloaking Setup
        var titleInput = document.getElementById("titleInput");
        var iconInput = document.getElementById("iconInput");
        var iconPreset = document.getElementById("iconPreset");
        var favicon = document.getElementById("favicon");

        var savedTitle = localStorage.getItem("wizzy_title");
        var savedIcon = localStorage.getItem("wizzy_icon");

        if (savedTitle) {
          document.title = savedTitle;
          titleInput.value = savedTitle;
        }
        if (savedIcon) {
          favicon.href = savedIcon;
          iconInput.value = savedIcon;
        }

        titleInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
          document.title = this.value || "Home";
          localStorage.setItem("wizzy_title", this.value);
        });

        iconPreset.addEventListener("change", function() {
          if (this.value !== "custom") {
            iconInput.value = this.value;
            favicon.href = this.value;
            localStorage.setItem("wizzy_icon", this.value);
          }
        });

        iconInput.addEventListener("input", function() {
          favicon.href = this.value;
          iconPreset.value = "custom";
          localStorage.setItem("wizzy_icon", this.value);
        });

        // 6. Base64 Tools
        var toolInput = document.getElementById("toolInput");
        var toolOutput = document.getElementById("toolOutput");

        document.getElementById("btnEncode").addEventListener("click", function() {
          var val = toolInput.value.trim();
          if (val) toolOutput.value = btoa(val);
        });

        document.getElementById("btnDecode").addEventListener("click", function() {
          var val = toolInput.value.trim();
          if (val) {
            try { toolOutput.value = atob(val); } 
            catch(e) { toolOutput.value = "Error: Invalid Base64 string"; }
          }
        });

        // 7. Themes & Custom Backgrounds
        var themeSelect = document.getElementById("themeSelect");
        var bgPatternSelect = document.getElementById("bgPatternSelect");

        function applyTheme(colorVal) {
          if (colorVal === "light") {
            document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", "light");
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--accent", "#0d1117");
          } else {
            document.documentElement.removeAttribute("data-theme");
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--accent", colorVal);
          }
        }

        function applyPattern(patternKey) {
          document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--bg-pattern", patterns[patternKey] || "none");
        }

        var savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("wizzy_theme") || "#e08e00";
        var savedPattern = localStorage.getItem("wizzy_pattern") || "none";

        themeSelect.value = savedTheme;
        bgPatternSelect.value = savedPattern;
        applyTheme(savedTheme);
        applyPattern(savedPattern);

        themeSelect.addEventListener("change", function() {
          applyTheme(this.value);
          localStorage.setItem("wizzy_theme", this.value);
        });

        bgPatternSelect.addEventListener("change", function() {
          applyPattern(this.value);
          localStorage.setItem("wizzy_pattern", this.value);
        });

        // 8. Clock System
        var clockToggle = document.getElementById("clockToggle");
        var liveClock = document.getElementById("liveClock");
        var clockInterval = null;

        function updateClock() {
          var now = new Date();
          liveClock.textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString();
        }

        function setClockState(enabled) {
          if (enabled) {
            liveClock.classList.add("active");
            updateClock();
            if (!clockInterval) clockInterval = setInterval(updateClock, 1000);
          } else {
            liveClock.classList.remove("active");
            if (clockInterval) {
              clearInterval(clockInterval);
              clockInterval = null;
            }
          }
        }

        var savedClockState = localStorage.getItem("wizzy_clock") === "true";
        clockToggle.checked = savedClockState;
        setClockState(savedClockState);

        clockToggle.addEventListener("change", function() {
          setClockState(this.checked);
          localStorage.setItem("wizzy_clock", this.checked);
        });
      }

      if (document.readyState === "loading") {
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
      } else {
        init();
      }
    })();
  </script>

</body></html>
